name: GridScrollApi
description: The scroll API interface that is available in the grid apiRef.

properties.name: scroll
properties.description: Triggers the viewport to scroll to the given positions (in pixels).

properties.name: scrollToIndexes
properties.description: Triggers the viewport to scroll to the cell at indexes given by params. rowIndex is the zero-based index in the full filtered and sorted row list, not the index within the current page. When pagination is enabled, rowIndex must point to a row on the current page. colIndex is the zero-based index in the visible columns. Invalid indexes return false without scrolling.
